```
  | .inr .q1T => .jeq 17 2 (.inr .q1d) (.inr .q1B)
  | .inr .q1B => .inc 17 (.inr .q1T)
  | .inr .q1d => .dec 17 (.inr .qsT)
  | .inr .qsT => .jz 17 (.inr .seek) (.inr .qsD)
  | .inr .qsD => .dec 17 (.inr (.qsI 0))
  | .inr (.qsI i) => .inc 16 (if i = 3 then .inr .qsT else .inr (.qsI (i + 1)))
  | .inr .seek => .jeq 15 16 (.inr .no) (.inr .probe)
  | .inr .probe => .jeq 17 13 (.inr .hit) (.inr .bump)
  | .inr .bump => .inc 17 (.inr (.sadv 0))
  | .inr (.sadv i) => .inc 15 (if i = 3 then .inr .seek else .inr (.sadv (i + 1)))
  | .inr .hit => if mode then .call 0 .whole [15] (.inr .yes) (.inr .no) else .ret true
  | .inr .yes => .ret true
  | .inr .no => .ret false

/-- **The bank's last phase.** From `q1T`, with `na + 1` in register `2`, the index `i` in
register `13` and the seek registers `15`, `16`, `17` clear, the bank answers: in mode `false`
whether `i < na`; in mode `true` letter `4i` of the input if `i < na`, and `0` otherwise.

**Proof sketch.** `registerCopy_loop` and one decrement load `na` into register `17`;
`registerScale_loop` at factor `4` moves `4 na` into the seek limit `16`; `indexedSeek_loop` at
stride `4` hits exactly when `i < na`, with its pointer at `4i`. -/
private theorem epad_bank_post (C d : ℕ) (mode : Bool) (z : List Bool) (B na i : ℕ)
    (v : Fin 18 → ℕ) (hv : ∀ r, v r ≤ B) (h2 : v 2 = na + 1) (h13 : v 13 = i)
    (h15 : v 15 = 0) (h16 : v 16 = 0) (h17 : v 17 = 0) (hB : 4 * na + 1 ≤ B) :
    AHalt (epadBA C d mode) epadOr z
      (fun a => PreS (epadBA C d mode) z a ∧ ∀ r, a.2.1 r ≤ B) (some (.inr .q1T), v, none)
      (if i < na then (if mode then z.getD (4 * i) false else true) else false) := by
  -- `17 := na + 1`, then `na`
  have hc1 := registerCopy_loop (epadBA C d mode) epadOr z 17 2 (by decide) (.inr .q1T)
    (.inr .q1B) (.inr .q1d) rfl rfl B v hv (by rw [h17]; exact Nat.zero_le _)
  obtain ⟨v₁, hv₁⟩ : ∃ w, w = Function.update v 17 (v 2) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  rw [← hv₁] at hc1
  have b₁ : ∀ r, v₁ r ≤ B := by rw [hv₁]; exact register_update_le v 17 B _ hv (hv 2)
  obtain ⟨v₂, hv₂⟩ : ∃ w, w = Function.update v₁ 17 na := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have b₂ : ∀ r, v₂ r ≤ B := by rw [hv₂]; exact register_update_le v₁ 17 B _ b₁ (by omega)
  have hd : AReach (epadBA C d mode) epadOr z
      (fun a => PreS (epadBA C d mode) z a ∧ ∀ r, a.2.1 r ≤ B) (some (.inr .q1d), v₁, none)
      (some (.inr .qsT), v₂, none) := by
    have hc : epadBA C d mode (.inr .q1d) = .dec 17 (.inr .qsT) := rfl
    refine AReach.step ⟨epad_preS hc trivial, b₁⟩ ?_
    rw [astep_dec hc, hv₂, hv₁, Function.update_self, h2, Nat.add_sub_cancel,
      Function.update_idem]
    exact AReach.refl _
  -- `16 += 4 · 17`, `17 := 0`
  have hsc := registerScale_loop (epadBA C d mode) epadOr z 17 16 (by decide) (.inr .qsT)
    (.inr .qsD) (.inr .seek) (fun i => if h : i < 4 then .inr (.qsI ⟨i, h⟩) else .inr .qsT) 4
    rfl rfl (fun i hi => by
      obtain rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl : i = 0 ∨ i = 1 ∨ i = 2 ∨ i = 3 := by omega
      all_goals rfl) rfl B v₂ b₂ (by
        rw [hv₂, Function.update_self, Function.update_of_ne (by decide), hv₁,
          Function.update_of_ne (by decide), h16]
        omega)
  obtain ⟨v₃, hv₃⟩ : ∃ w, w = Function.update (Function.update v₂ 17 0) 16
      (v₂ 16 + 4 * v₂ 17) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  rw [← hv₃] at hsc
  have h₃ : ∀ r, v₃ r = if r = 16 then 4 * na else if r = 17 then 0 else v r := by
    intro r
    rw [hv₃, hv₂, hv₁]
    simp only [Function.update_apply, Fin.reduceEq, ↓reduceIte, h16]
    split_ifs <;> subst_vars <;> simp_all
  have b₃ : ∀ r, v₃ r ≤ B := by
    intro r; rw [h₃]; split_ifs
    · omega
    · exact Nat.zero_le _
    · exact hv r
  -- the seek
  have hseek := indexedSeek_loop (epadBA C d mode) epadOr z 15 16 17 13 (by decide) (by decide)
    (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (.inr .seek) (.inr .probe) (.inr .bump)
    (.inr .hit) (.inr .no) (fun i => if h : i < 4 then .inr (.sadv ⟨i, h⟩) else .inr .seek) 4 B
    (by omega) rfl rfl rfl (fun i hi => by
      obtain rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl : i = 0 ∨ i = 1 ∨ i = 2 ∨ i = 3 := by omega
      all_goals rfl) rfl na v₃ b₃
    (by rw [h₃, h₃]; simp only [Fin.reduceEq, ↓reduceIte, h15]; omega)
    (by rw [h₃]; simp only [Fin.reduceEq, ↓reduceIte]; omega)
    (by rw [h₃]; simp only [Fin.reduceEq, ↓reduceIte]; exact Nat.zero_le _)
  have h313 : v₃ 13 = i := by rw [h₃]; simp only [Fin.reduceEq, ↓reduceIte, h13]
  have h317 : v₃ 17 = 0 := by rw [h₃]; simp only [Fin.reduceEq, ↓reduceIte]
  have h315 : v₃ 15 = 0 := by rw [h₃]; simp only [Fin.reduceEq, ↓reduceIte, h15]
  rw [h313, h317, Nat.zero_add] at hseek
  refine hc1.halt (hd.halt (hsc.halt ?_))
  by_cases hi : i < na
  · rw [if_pos hi] at hseek ⊢
    obtain ⟨v₄, hv₄⟩ : ∃ w, w = Function.update (Function.update v₃ 15 (v₃ 15 + 4 * (i - 0)))
        17 i := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    rw [← hv₄] at hseek
    have b₄ : ∀ r, v₄ r ≤ B := by
      rw [hv₄]
      refine register_update_le _ 17 B _ (register_update_le _ 15 B _ b₃ ?_) (by omega)
      rw [h315]; omega
    have h415 : v₄ 15 = 4 * i := by
      rw [hv₄, Function.update_of_ne (by decide), Function.update_self, h315]; omega
    refine hseek.halt ?_
    cases mode with
    | false =>
      exact AHalt.ret rfl ⟨epad_preS (show epadBA C d false (.inr .hit) = .ret true from rfl)
        trivial, b₄⟩
    | true =>
      have hc : epadBA C d true (.inr .hit) = .call 0 .whole [15] (.inr .yes) (.inr .no) := rfl
      refine AHalt.step ⟨epad_preS hc (List.nodup_singleton _), b₄⟩ ?_
      rw [astep_call hc, vword_whole₁, h415]
      have ho : epadOr 0 (pairEncode z (Nat.bits (4 * i))) = z.getD (4 * i) false :=
        (epadIn_answer z (4 * i)).1
      rw [ho]
      cases hb : z.getD (4 * i) false
      · exact AHalt.ret rfl ⟨epad_preS (show epadBA C d true (.inr .no) = .ret false from rfl)
          trivial, b₄⟩
      · exact AHalt.ret rfl ⟨epad_preS (show epadBA C d true (.inr .yes) = .ret true from rfl)
          trivial, b₄⟩
  · rw [if_neg hi] at hseek ⊢
    obtain ⟨v₄, hv₄⟩ : ∃ w, w = Function.update (Function.update v₃ 15 (v₃ 16)) 17 na :=
      ⟨_, rfl⟩
    rw [← hv₄] at hseek
    have b₄ : ∀ r, v₄ r ≤ B := by
      rw [hv₄]
      exact register_update_le _ 17 B _ (register_update_le _ 15 B _ b₃ (b₃ 16)) (by omega)
    exact hseek.halt (AHalt.ret rfl ⟨epad_preS
      (show epadBA C d mode (.inr .no) = .ret false from rfl) trivial, b₄⟩)

/-- **The bank's first phase.** From the start, the bank counts `|z|` and parses
`z = ⟨y, w⟩`; it rejects a word that is not a pair, or whose index word `w` is not canonical
or wider than `|y|`; otherwise it decodes `i = bitsVal w` into register `13` and enters the
validity block with its pointer `0`, its limit `2 |y|` and its working registers clear, the
seek registers `15`–`17` clear, all registers at most `B`.

**Proof sketch.** `inputLength_loop`; `alignedPair_loop` at stride `1` on `z`; three
`registerCopy_loop`s, two decrements and a halving set the tail base `2|y| + 2`, the block's
limit `2|y|` and the cap `|y|`; `canonicalTail_loop` checks the index word; one more copy moves
the pointer to the end, and `boundedDecode_loop` decodes the index (its values stay below
`2 ^ |bits |y||` by `LogProg.bitsVal_lt_two_pow`). -/
private theorem epad_bank_pre (C d : ℕ) (mode : Bool) (z : List Bool) (B : ℕ)
    (hB : 2 * z.length + 1 ≤ B) :
    (pairDecode z = none → ∃ v, (∀ r, v r ≤ B) ∧
      AReach (epadBA C d mode) epadOr z (fun a => PreS (epadBA C d mode) z a ∧ ∀ r, a.2.1 r ≤ B)
        (some (.inr .lscan), fun _ => 0, none) (some (.inr .no), v, none)) ∧
    (∀ y w, pairDecode z = some (y, w) →
      (¬ (w.getLastD true = true ∧ w.length ≤ (Nat.bits y.length).length) → ∃ v, (∀ r, v r ≤ B) ∧
        AReach (epadBA C d mode) epadOr z
          (fun a => PreS (epadBA C d mode) z a ∧ ∀ r, a.2.1 r ≤ B)
          (some (.inr .lscan), fun _ => 0, none) (some (.inr .no), v, none)) ∧
      (w.getLastD true = true ∧ w.length ≤ (Nat.bits y.length).length → ∃ v, (∀ r, v r ≤ B) ∧
        v 0 = 0 ∧ v 1 = 2 * y.length ∧ (∀ r : Fin 18, 2 ≤ r.val → r.val ≤ 8 → v r = 0) ∧
        v 13 = LogProg.bitsVal w ∧ v 15 = 0 ∧ v 16 = 0 ∧ v 17 = 0 ∧
        AReach (epadBA C d mode) epadOr z
          (fun a => PreS (epadBA C d mode) z a ∧ ∀ r, a.2.1 r ≤ B)
          (some (.inr .lscan), fun _ => 0, none) (some (.inl .scan), v, none))) := by
  -- the length
  have hlen := inputLength_loop (epadBA C d mode) epadOr z 9 1 (.inr .lscan) (.inr .linc)
    (.inr .zscan) rfl rfl (fun n _ => (epadIn_answer z n).2) B (by omega) (fun _ => 0)
    (fun _ => Nat.zero_le _) (Nat.zero_le _)
  obtain ⟨v₀, hv₀⟩ : ∃ w, w = Function.update (fun _ : Fin 18 => 0) 9 z.length := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  rw [← hv₀] at hlen
  have b₀ : ∀ r, v₀ r ≤ B := by
    rw [hv₀]; exact register_update_le _ 9 B _ (fun _ => Nat.zero_le _) (by omega)
  have h₀ : ∀ r : Fin 18, r ≠ 9 → v₀ r = 0 := fun r hr => by
    rw [hv₀, Function.update_of_ne hr]
  have h₀9 : v₀ 9 = z.length := by rw [hv₀, Function.update_self]
  -- the outer pair scan
  have hap := alignedPair_loop (epadBA C d mode) epadOr z 10 9 0 (.inr .zscan) (.inr .zfirst)
    (fun b => .inr (.ztest b)) (fun b => .inr (.zread b)) (.inr .no) (.inr .c1T)
    (fun k i => if i = 0 then .inr (.zadv k) else .inr (epadZEnd k)) 1 B (by omega) (by decide)
    rfl rfl (fun _ => rfl) (fun _ => rfl)
    (fun k i hi => by obtain rfl : i = 0 := by omega
                      rfl)
    ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩ z v₀ b₀ (by rw [h₀9, h₀ 10 (by decide)]; omega)
    (fun i _ => by rw [h₀ 10 (by decide), Nat.zero_add, Nat.one_mul]
                   exact (epadIn_answer z i).1)
  refine ⟨fun hd => ?_, fun y w hd => ?_⟩
  · simp only [hd] at hap
    obtain ⟨t, ht, hr⟩ := hap
    exact ⟨_, register_update_le v₀ 10 B _ b₀ (by rw [h₀ 10 (by decide)]; omega), hlen.trans hr⟩
  simp only [hd] at hap
  have hz : z = pairEncode y w := eq_pairEncode_of_pairDecode z y w hd
  have hzl : z.length = 2 * y.length + 2 + w.length := by rw [hz, length_pairEncode]
  obtain ⟨v₁, hv₁⟩ : ∃ u, u = Function.update v₀ 10 (v₀ 10 + 1 * (2 * y.length + 2)) :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  rw [← hv₁] at hap
  have b₁ : ∀ r, v₁ r ≤ B := by
    rw [hv₁]; exact register_update_le v₀ 10 B _ b₀ (by rw [h₀ 10 (by decide)]; omega)
  have h₁10 : v₁ 10 = 2 * y.length + 2 := by
    rw [hv₁, Function.update_self, h₀ 10 (by decide)]; omega
  -- the tail base, the block's limit and the cap
  have hc1 := registerCopy_loop (epadBA C d mode) epadOr z 11 10 (by decide) (.inr .c1T)
    (.inr .c1B) (.inr .c2T) rfl rfl B v₁ b₁ (by
      rw [hv₁, Function.update_of_ne (by decide), h₀ 11 (by decide)]; exact Nat.zero_le _)
  obtain ⟨v₂, hv₂⟩ : ∃ u, u = Function.update v₁ 11 (v₁ 10) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  rw [← hv₂] at hc1
  have b₂ : ∀ r, v₂ r ≤ B := by rw [hv₂]; exact register_update_le v₁ 11 B _ b₁ (b₁ 10)
  have hc2 := registerCopy_loop (epadBA C d mode) epadOr z 1 10 (by decide) (.inr .c2T)
    (.inr .c2B) (.inr .dd1) rfl rfl B v₂ b₂ (by
      rw [hv₂, Function.update_of_ne (by decide), hv₁, Function.update_of_ne (by decide),
        h₀ 1 (by decide)]
      exact Nat.zero_le _)
  obtain ⟨v₃, hv₃⟩ : ∃ u, u = Function.update v₂ 1 (v₂ 10) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  rw [← hv₃] at hc2
  have b₃ : ∀ r, v₃ r ≤ B := by rw [hv₃]; exact register_update_le v₂ 1 B _ b₂ (b₂ 10)
  have h₂10 : v₂ 10 = 2 * y.length + 2 := by
    rw [hv₂, Function.update_of_ne (by decide), h₁10]
  obtain ⟨v₄, hv₄⟩ : ∃ u, u = Function.update v₃ 1 (2 * y.length) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have b₄ : ∀ r, v₄ r ≤ B := by rw [hv₄]; exact register_update_le v₃ 1 B _ b₃ (by omega)
  have hdd : AReach (epadBA C d mode) epadOr z
      (fun a => PreS (epadBA C d mode) z a ∧ ∀ r, a.2.1 r ≤ B) (some (.inr .dd1), v₃, none)
      (some (.inr .c3T), v₄, none) := by
    have hc : epadBA C d mode (.inr .dd1) = .dec 1 (.inr .dd2) := rfl
    have hc' : epadBA C d mode (.inr .dd2) = .dec 1 (.inr .c3T) := rfl
    refine AReach.step ⟨epad_preS hc trivial, b₃⟩ ?_
    rw [astep_dec hc]
    refine AReach.step ⟨epad_preS hc' trivial,
      register_update_le v₃ 1 B _ b₃ ((Nat.sub_le _ _).trans (b₃ 1))⟩ ?_
    rw [astep_dec hc']
    have e : Function.update (Function.update v₃ 1 (v₃ 1 - 1)) 1
        (Function.update v₃ 1 (v₃ 1 - 1) 1 - 1) = v₄ := by
      rw [hv₄, hv₃]
      funext s
      simp only [Function.update_apply]
      split_ifs <;> simp_all
    rw [e]
    exact AReach.refl _
  have hc3 := registerCopy_loop (epadBA C d mode) epadOr z 12 1 (by decide) (.inr .c3T)
    (.inr .c3B) (.inr .hcap) rfl rfl B v₄ b₄ (by
      rw [hv₄, Function.update_of_ne (by decide), hv₃, Function.update_of_ne (by decide), hv₂,
        Function.update_of_ne (by decide), hv₁, Function.update_of_ne (by decide),
        h₀ 12 (by decide)]
      exact Nat.zero_le _)
  obtain ⟨v₅, hv₅⟩ : ∃ u, u = Function.update v₄ 12 (v₄ 1) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  rw [← hv₅] at hc3
  have b₅ : ∀ r, v₅ r ≤ B := by rw [hv₅]; exact register_update_le v₄ 12 B _ b₄ (b₄ 1)
  obtain ⟨v₆, hv₆⟩ : ∃ u, u = Function.update v₅ 12 y.length := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have b₆ : ∀ r, v₆ r ≤ B := by rw [hv₆]; exact register_update_le v₅ 12 B _ b₅ (by omega)
  have hhc : AReach (epadBA C d mode) epadOr z
      (fun a => PreS (epadBA C d mode) z a ∧ ∀ r, a.2.1 r ≤ B) (some (.inr .hcap), v₅, none)
      (some (.inr (.ttest true)), v₆, none) := by
    have hc : epadBA C d mode (.inr .hcap) = .half 12 (.inr (.ttest true)) := rfl
    refine AReach.step ⟨epad_preS hc trivial, b₅⟩ ?_
    rw [astep_half hc]
    have e : Function.update v₅ 12 (v₅ 12 / 2) = v₆ := by
      rw [hv₆, hv₅]
      funext s
      simp only [Function.update_apply]
      split_ifs <;> simp_all
    rw [e]
    exact AReach.refl _
  -- the register file before the tail check
  have h₆ : ∀ r : Fin 18, v₆ r = if r = 1 then 2 * y.length else if r = 9 then z.length
      else if r = 10 then 2 * y.length + 2 else if r = 11 then 2 * y.length + 2
      else if r = 12 then y.length else 0 := by
    intro r
    rw [hv₆, hv₅, hv₄, hv₃, hv₂, hv₁, hv₀]
    simp only [Function.update_apply, Fin.reduceEq, ↓reduceIte]
    split_ifs <;> simp_all
  -- the tail check
  have hct := canonicalTail_loop (epadBA C d mode) epadOr z 10 9 12 (by decide) (by decide)
    (by decide) 0 (fun b => .inr (.ttest b)) (.inr .tcheck) (.inr .tread) (.inr .no) (.inr .c4T)
    (fun b => .inr (.thalve b)) (fun b i => if i = 0 then .inr (.tadv b) else .inr (.ttest b))
    1 B (by omega) (fun _ => rfl) rfl rfl (fun _ => rfl)
    (fun b i hi => by obtain rfl : i = 0 := by omega
                      rfl)
    (fun _ => rfl) w true v₆ b₆ (by rw [h₆, h₆]; simp only [Fin.reduceEq, ↓reduceIte]; omega)
    (fun i hi => by
      rw [h₆]; simp only [Fin.reduceEq, ↓reduceIte, Nat.one_mul]
      rw [(epadIn_answer z _).1, hz, pairEncode_getD_snd])
  obtain ⟨v', b', hp', hfr', hct⟩ := hct
  have h612 : v₆ 12 = y.length := by rw [h₆]; simp only [Fin.reduceEq, ↓reduceIte]
  rw [h612] at hct
  refine ⟨fun hbad => ?_, fun hok => ?_⟩
  · have hno : (if w.length ≤ (Nat.bits y.length).length then
        (if w.getLastD true = true then (Sum.inr EPadBX.c4T : EPadVL C d ⊕ EPadBX)
          else .inr .no) else .inr .no) = .inr .no := by
      split_ifs with h1 h2
      · exact absurd ⟨h2, h1⟩ hbad
      · rfl
      · rfl
    rw [hno] at hct
    exact ⟨v', b', hlen.trans (hap.trans (hc1.trans (hc2.trans (hdd.trans (hc3.trans
      (hhc.trans hct))))))⟩
  rw [if_pos hok.2, if_pos hok.1] at hct
  -- the pointer to the end, then the decoder
  have h'9 : v' 9 = z.length := by
    rw [hfr' 9 (by decide) (by decide), h₆]; simp only [Fin.reduceEq, ↓reduceIte]
  have hc4 := registerCopy_loop (epadBA C d mode) epadOr z 10 9 (by decide) (.inr .c4T)
    (.inr .c4B) (.inr .dtest) rfl rfl B v' b' (by
      rw [h'9]; rw [h₆] at hp'; simp only [Fin.reduceEq, ↓reduceIte] at hp'; exact hp')
  obtain ⟨v₇, hv₇⟩ : ∃ u, u = Function.update v' 10 (v' 9) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  rw [← hv₇] at hc4
  have b₇ : ∀ r, v₇ r ≤ B := by rw [hv₇]; exact register_update_le v' 10 B _ b' (b' 9)
  have h₇ : ∀ r : Fin 18, r ≠ 10 → r ≠ 12 → v₇ r = v₆ r := fun r h10 h12 => by
    rw [hv₇, Function.update_of_ne h10, hfr' r h10 h12]
  have hw : w.length ≤ (Nat.bits y.length).length := hok.2
  have hval : ∀ i ≤ w.length, LogProg.bitsVal (w.drop i) ≤ B := by
    intro i _
    have h1 := LogProg.bitsVal_lt_two_pow (w.drop i)
    have h2 : 2 ^ (w.drop i).length ≤ 2 ^ (Nat.bits y.length).length :=
      Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by omega) ((by simp : (w.drop i).length ≤ w.length).trans hw)
    by_cases hy0 : y.length = 0
    · rw [hy0, Nat.zero_bits, List.length_nil, pow_zero] at h2
      omega
    · have h3 := LogProg.two_pow_bits_le y.length (by omega)
      omega
  have hdec := boundedDecode_loop (epadBA C d mode) epadOr z 10 11 13 14 (by decide)
    (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) 0 (.inr .dtest) (.inr .ddown)
    (.inr .dread) (.inl .scan) (fun b => .inr (.dcopy b)) (fun b => .inr (.dbump b))
    (fun b => .inr (.dclear b)) (fun b => .inr (.dscale b)) (fun b => .inr (.dtake b))
    (fun b => .inr (.dadd b))
    (fun b i => if i = 0 then .inr (.dinc b false) else if i = 1 then .inr (.dinc b true)
      else .inr (.dscale b))
    rfl rfl rfl (fun _ => rfl) (fun _ => rfl) (fun _ => rfl) (fun _ => rfl) (fun _ => rfl)
    (fun b i hi => by
      obtain rfl | rfl : i = 0 ∨ i = 1 := by omega
      all_goals rfl)
    (fun _ => rfl) (fun b => by cases b <;> rfl) w B hval w.length le_rfl v₇ b₇
    (by rw [hv₇, Function.update_self, h'9, Function.update_of_ne (by decide),
          hfr' 11 (by decide) (by decide), h₆]
        simp only [Fin.reduceEq, ↓reduceIte]; omega)
    (by rw [h₇ 13 (by decide) (by decide), h₆, List.drop_length]
        simp only [Fin.reduceEq, ↓reduceIte]
        rw [← Nat.zero_bits, LogProg.bitsVal_bits])
    (by rw [h₇ 14 (by decide) (by decide), h₆]; simp only [Fin.reduceEq, ↓reduceIte])
    (fun i hi => by
      rw [h₇ 11 (by decide) (by decide), h₆]; simp only [Fin.reduceEq, ↓reduceIte]
      rw [(epadIn_answer z _).1, hz, pairEncode_getD_snd])
  obtain ⟨v'', b'', -, h''13, -, hfr'', hdec⟩ := hdec
  have h'' : ∀ r : Fin 18, r ≠ 10 → r ≠ 12 → r ≠ 13 → r ≠ 14 → v'' r = v₆ r :=
    fun r h10 h12 h13 h14 => by rw [hfr'' r h10 h13 h14, h₇ r h10 h12]
  refine ⟨v'', b'', ?_, ?_, fun r h2 h8 => ?_, h''13, ?_, ?_, ?_, hlen.trans (hap.trans
    (hc1.trans (hc2.trans (hdd.trans (hc3.trans (hhc.trans (hct.trans (hc4.trans hdec))))))))⟩
  · rw [h'' 0 (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide), h₆]
    simp only [Fin.reduceEq, ↓reduceIte]
  · rw [h'' 1 (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide), h₆]
    simp only [↓reduceIte]
  · have hne : ∀ k : Fin 18, 9 ≤ k.val → r ≠ k := fun k hk h => by rw [h] at h8; omega
    have hne1 : r ≠ 1 := fun h => by rw [h] at h2; simp at h2
    rw [h'' r (hne 10 (by decide)) (hne 12 (by decide)) (hne 13 (by decide))
      (hne 14 (by decide)), h₆, if_neg hne1, if_neg (hne 9 (by decide)),
      if_neg (hne 10 (by decide)), if_neg (hne 11 (by decide)), if_neg (hne 12 (by decide))]
  · rw [h'' 15 (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide), h₆]
    simp only [Fin.reduceEq, ↓reduceIte]
  · rw [h'' 16 (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide), h₆]
    simp only [Fin.reduceEq, ↓reduceIte]
  · rw [h'' 17 (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide), h₆]
    simp only [Fin.reduceEq, ↓reduceIte]

/-- Letter `4i` of `⟨⟨a, b⟩, w⟩` is letter `i` of `a`, for `i < |a|`. -/
private lemma epad_getD_four (a b w : List Bool) (i : ℕ) (hi : i < a.length) :
    (pairEncode (pairEncode a b) w).getD (4 * i) false = a.getD i false := by
  rw [pairEncode_getD, if_pos (by rw [length_pairEncode]; omega),
    show 4 * i / 2 = 2 * i by omega, pairEncode_getD, if_pos (by omega),
    show 2 * i / 2 = i by omega]

/-- **The bank**: both query languages are decided in logarithmic space.

**Proof sketch.** `arm_decides_poly` on `epadBA`: the first phase `epad_bank_pre` parses the
query and decodes its index (rejecting malformed queries), the validity block `epad_val_run`
runs at stride `2` on the first field (rejecting unpadded words), and `epad_bank_post` answers.
Registers stay below `(C + d + 8)(|z| + 1)^{d + 1}`. -/
private theorem epad_Q_mem (C d : ℕ) (mode : Bool) : epadQ C d mode ∈ LOGSPACE := by
  classical
  letI := epadVLFintype C d
  letI := epadBXFintype
  refine arm_decides_poly (epadBA C d mode) (.inr .lscan) epadIn epadIn_mem (C + d + 8) (d + 1)
    fun z => ?_
  have hB := epad_bound C d z.length
  obtain ⟨hnone, hsome⟩ := epad_bank_pre C d mode z ((C + d + 8) * (z.length + 1) ^ (d + 1))
    (by omega)
  have hno : ∀ v : Fin 18 → ℕ, (∀ r, v r ≤ (C + d + 8) * (z.length + 1) ^ (d + 1)) →
      AHalt (epadBA C d mode) epadOr z (fun a => PreS (epadBA C d mode) z a ∧
        ∀ r, a.2.1 r ≤ (C + d + 8) * (z.length + 1) ^ (d + 1)) (some (.inr .no), v, none)
        false := fun v hv =>
    AHalt.ret rfl ⟨epad_preS (show epadBA C d mode (.inr .no) = .ret false from rfl) trivial, hv⟩
  cases hd : pairDecode z with
  | none =>
    obtain ⟨v, hv, hr⟩ := hnone hd
    have hans : MultiTapeTM.indicator (epadQ C d mode : Set (List Bool)) z = false := by
      rw [indicator_eq_decide]; exact decide_eq_false (epad_not_mem_Q hd)
    rw [hans]
    exact hr.halt (hno v hv)
  | some yw =>
    obtain ⟨y, w⟩ := yw
    obtain ⟨hbad, hok⟩ := hsome y w hd
    have hz : z = pairEncode y w := eq_pairEncode_of_pairDecode z y w hd
    have hzl : z.length = 2 * y.length + 2 + w.length := by rw [hz, length_pairEncode]
    by_cases hw : w.getLastD true = true ∧ w.length ≤ (Nat.bits y.length).length
    · obtain ⟨v, hv, h0, h1, hzr, h13, h15, h16, h17, hr⟩ := hok hw
      have hpowy : C * (y.length + 1) ^ d ≤ C * (z.length + 1) ^ d :=
        Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (Nat.pow_le_pow_left (by omega) _)
      obtain ⟨v', hfr, hb', hval2, hr'⟩ := epad_val_run (epadBA C d mode) epadOr z y true C d
        Sum.inl (.inr .q1T) (.inr .no) (fun _ => rfl)
        (fun j hj => by
          rw [show epadS true * j = 2 * j from rfl, (epadIn_answer z _).1, hz, pairEncode_getD,
            if_pos (by omega), show 2 * j / 2 = j by omega])
        ((C + d + 8) * (z.length + 1) ^ (d + 1)) (by omega) v hv h0 h1 hzr
      by_cases hvy : epadValid C d y
      · rw [if_pos hvy] at hr'
        obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hvy
        have hfst : pairFstD y = a := by rw [ha, pairFstD_pairEncode]
        have hya : y.length = 2 * a.length + 2 + C * (a.length + 1) ^ d := by
          rw [ha, length_pairEncode, List.length_replicate]
        have hpost := epad_bank_post C d mode z ((C + d + 8) * (z.length + 1) ^ (d + 1))
          a.length (LogProg.bitsVal w) v' hb' (by rw [hval2 ⟨a, ha⟩, hfst])
          (by rw [hfr 13 (by decide), h13]) (by rw [hfr 15 (by decide), h15])
          (by rw [hfr 16 (by decide), h16]) (by rw [hfr 17 (by decide), h17]) (by omega)
        have hans : MultiTapeTM.indicator (epadQ C d mode : Set (List Bool)) z =
            (if LogProg.bitsVal w < a.length then
              (if mode then z.getD (4 * LogProg.bitsVal w) false else true) else false) := by
          rw [indicator_eq_decide]
          have hm := epad_mem_Q_iff (C := C) (d := d) (mode := mode) hd
          rw [hfst] at hm
          by_cases hi : LogProg.bitsVal w < a.length
          · rw [if_pos hi]
            cases mode with
            | false =>
              exact decide_eq_true (hm.mpr ⟨hw.1, hw.2, ⟨a, ha⟩, by simpa using hi⟩)
            | true =>
              have h4 : z.getD (4 * LogProg.bitsVal w) false = a.getD (LogProg.bitsVal w) false :=
                by rw [hz, ha, epad_getD_four a _ w _ hi]
              rw [if_pos rfl, h4]
              cases hb : a.getD (LogProg.bitsVal w) false
              · refine decide_eq_false (fun h => ?_)
                have h5 := (hm.mp h).2.2.2
                rw [if_pos rfl, hb] at h5
                exact Bool.false_ne_true h5
              · exact decide_eq_true (hm.mpr ⟨hw.1, hw.2, ⟨a, ha⟩, by rw [if_pos rfl]; exact hb⟩)
          · rw [if_neg hi]
            refine decide_eq_false (fun h => ?_)
            have h4 := (hm.mp h).2.2.2
            cases mode with
            | false => exact hi (by simpa using h4)
            | true =>
              simp only [if_true] at h4
              rw [List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD, List.getElem?_eq_none (by omega),
                Option.getD_none] at h4
              exact Bool.false_ne_true h4
        rw [hans]
        exact hr.halt (hr'.halt hpost)
      · rw [if_neg hvy] at hr'
        have hans : MultiTapeTM.indicator (epadQ C d mode : Set (List Bool)) z = false := by
          rw [indicator_eq_decide]
          exact decide_eq_false (fun h => hvy ((epad_mem_Q_iff hd).mp h).2.2.1)
        rw [hans]
        exact hr.halt (hr'.halt (hno v' hb'))
    · obtain ⟨v, hv, hr⟩ := hbad hw
      have hans : MultiTapeTM.indicator (epadQ C d mode : Set (List Bool)) z = false := by
        rw [indicator_eq_decide]
        exact decide_eq_false (fun h => hw ⟨((epad_mem_Q_iff hd).mp h).1,
          ((epad_mem_Q_iff hd).mp h).2.1⟩)
      rw [hans]
      exact hr.halt (hno v hv)

/-! ### The run phase -/

/-- **The run phase**: the oracle-input simulator runs `L`'s decider on the
virtual input `epadVirt y`, answered by the bank, within `K · T |y|` work cells, on every input.

**Proof sketch.** `LogProg.OIS.compile_decides` with `L`'s decider `M` (space `c · S`) and the
bank `![M₀, M₁]` of `epadQ`'s deciders (space `c_j · logSpace`), whose laws on genuine queries
are `epad_query_mem_iff`. With `m = |y|` and `v = epadVirt y`: on a padded `y = ⟨a, 1^{…}⟩`,
`m = 2|a| + 2 + C (|a| + 1)^d`, so `S |v| ≤ T m` by `hST`; otherwise `v = []` and
`S 0 ≤ S 0 · T m`. The index register costs `|bits (|v| + 1)| + 2 ≤ 4 T m` and the bank
`k_D (2B + 1)` with `B = (c₀ + c₁)(3m + 4) + 1`, so `2B + 1 ≤ (8 (c₀ + c₁) + 3) T m`. -/
private theorem epad_run {L : Language Bool} {S T : ℕ → ℕ} (C d : ℕ) (hL : L ∈ SPACE S)
    (hST : ∀ n, S n ≤ T (2 * n + 2 + C * (n + 1) ^ d)) (hT : ∀ m, m + 1 ≤ T m) :
    ∃ (K : ℕ) (O : FinTM Bool), O.ComputesInSpace
      (fun y => [MultiTapeTM.indicator (L : Set (List Bool)) (epadVirt C d y)])
      (fun n => K * T n) := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨c, M, hM⟩ := mem_SPACE_iff.mp hL
  have hQ0 := epad_Q_mem C d false
  have hQ1 := epad_Q_mem C d true
  rw [LOGSPACE_eq, mem_SPACE_iff] at hQ0 hQ1
  obtain ⟨c0, M0, h0⟩ := hQ0
  obtain ⟨c1, M1, h1⟩ := hQ1
  let Ms : Fin 2 → FinTM Bool := ![M0, M1]
  let As : Fin 2 → Language Bool := ![epadQ C d false, epadQ C d true]
  let sb : Fin 2 → ℕ → ℕ := ![fun n => c0 * logSpace n, fun n => c1 * logSpace n]
  have hMs : ∀ j, (Ms j).DecidesInSpace (As j) (sb j) := by
    intro j
    refine Fin.cases ?_ (Fin.cases ?_ (fun i => Fin.elim0 i)) j
    · show M0.DecidesInSpace (epadQ C d false) (fun n => c0 * logSpace n)
      exact h0
    · show M1.DecidesInSpace (epadQ C d true) (fun n => c1 * logSpace n)
      exact h1
  have hsb : ∀ j q, sb j q ≤ (c0 + c1) * (q + 1) := by
    intro j q
    refine Fin.cases ?_ (Fin.cases ?_ (fun i => Fin.elim0 i)) j
    · show c0 * logSpace q ≤ (c0 + c1) * (q + 1)
      exact Nat.mul_le_mul (Nat.le_add_right _ _) (logSpace_le_succ q)
    · show c1 * logSpace q ≤ (c0 + c1) * (q + 1)
      exact Nat.mul_le_mul (Nat.le_add_left _ _) (logSpace_le_succ q)
  refine ⟨M.k * (2 * c * (S 0 + 1) + 1) + 4 +
      (LogProg.bankK Ms + LogProg.bankK Ms) * (8 * (c0 + c1) + 3),
    LogProg.compileFinTM (LogProg.OIS.prog M) (LogProg.OIS.start M) (LogProg.bankTM Ms)
      (LogProg.bankStart Ms), ?_⟩
  rw [FinTM.computesInSpace_iff]
  intro y
  set v := epadVirt C d y with hv
  obtain ⟨t, ht, hs⟩ :=
    (FinTM.computesInSpace_iff _ _ _).mp ((FinTM.decidesInSpace_iff _ _ _).mp hM) v
  have hvm : v.length ≤ y.length := epadVirt_length_le C d y
  set B := (c0 + c1) * (3 * y.length + 4) + 1 with hB
  have hbits : ∀ i ≤ v.length, (Nat.bits i).length ≤ y.length + 1 := by
    intro i hi
    exact (Turing.length_bits_le_self i).trans ((hi.trans hvm).trans (Nat.le_succ _))
  have hBnd : ∀ j, ∀ i ≤ v.length,
      max (sb j (pairEncode y (Nat.bits i)).length) 1 ≤ B := by
    intro j i hi
    have hq := hsb j (pairEncode y (Nat.bits i)).length
    rw [length_pairEncode] at hq ⊢
    have hb := hbits i hi
    have hmono : (c0 + c1) * (2 * y.length + 2 + (Nat.bits i).length + 1) ≤
        (c0 + c1) * (3 * y.length + 4) :=
      Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (by omega)
    refine max_le ?_ (by omega)
    omega
  have hA0 : ∀ i ≤ v.length,
      pairEncode y (Nat.bits i) ∈ As 0 ↔ i < v.length := by
    intro i hi
    show pairEncode y (Nat.bits i) ∈ epadQ C d false ↔ i < v.length
    rw [epad_query_mem_iff C d false y i (hi.trans hvm)]
    simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, if_false]
    by_cases hval : epadValid C d y
    · rw [hv, epadVirt_of_valid hval]
      exact ⟨fun h => h.2, fun h => ⟨hval, h⟩⟩
    · rw [hv, epadVirt_of_not_valid hval]
      exact ⟨fun h => absurd h.1 hval, fun h => absurd h (Nat.not_lt_zero _)⟩
  have hA1 : ∀ i < v.length,
      pairEncode y (Nat.bits i) ∈ As 1 ↔ v.getD i false = true := by
    intro i hi
    show pairEncode y (Nat.bits i) ∈ epadQ C d true ↔ v.getD i false = true
    rw [epad_query_mem_iff C d true y i (hi.le.trans hvm)]
    simp only [if_true]
    by_cases hval : epadValid C d y
    · rw [hv, epadVirt_of_valid hval]
      exact ⟨fun h => h.2, fun h => ⟨hval, h⟩⟩
    · rw [hv, epadVirt_of_not_valid hval] at hi
      exact absurd hi (Nat.not_lt_zero _)
  obtain ⟨T', hT', hSp⟩ := LogProg.OIS.compile_decides M Ms As sb hMs y v
    [MultiTapeTM.indicator (L : Set (List Bool)) v] hA0 hA1 t ht B hBnd
  refine ⟨T', hT', hSp.trans ?_⟩
  -- the space ledger
  have hTm := hT y.length
  have hS : S v.length ≤ (S 0 + 1) * T y.length := by
    by_cases hval : epadValid C d y
    · obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hval
      have hva : v.length = a.length := by
        rw [hv, epadVirt_of_valid ⟨a, ha⟩, ha, pairFstD_pairEncode]
      have hma : y.length = 2 * a.length + 2 + C * (a.length + 1) ^ d := by
        rw [ha, length_pairEncode, List.length_replicate]
      rw [hva]
      have h1 := hST a.length
      rw [← hma] at h1
      calc S a.length ≤ T y.length := h1
        _ ≤ (S 0 + 1) * T y.length := Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left _ (Nat.succ_pos _)
    · have hv0 : v.length = 0 := by rw [hv, epadVirt_of_not_valid hval]; rfl
      rw [hv0]
      calc S 0 ≤ S 0 * T y.length := Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right _ (by omega)
        _ ≤ (S 0 + 1) * T y.length := Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (Nat.le_succ _)
  have hsp : M.tm.spaceUsed (M.tm.initCfg v) t ≤ c * ((S 0 + 1) * T y.length) :=
    hs.trans (Nat.mul_le_mul_left c hS)
  have hW : (Nat.bits (v.length + 1)).length + 2 ≤ 4 * T y.length := by
    have h1 := Turing.length_bits_le_self (v.length + 1)
    omega
  have h2B : 2 * B + 1 ≤ (8 * (c0 + c1) + 3) * T y.length := by
    have h1 : (c0 + c1) * (3 * y.length + 4) ≤ (c0 + c1) * (4 * T y.length) :=
      Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (by omega)
    have e : (8 * (c0 + c1) + 3) * T y.length =
        2 * ((c0 + c1) * (4 * T y.length)) + 3 * T y.length := by ring
    rw [e, hB]
    omega
  have hk1 : M.k * (2 * M.tm.spaceUsed (M.tm.initCfg v) t + 1) ≤
      M.k * ((2 * c * (S 0 + 1) + 1) * T y.length) := by
    apply Nat.mul_le_mul_left
    have e : (2 * c * (S 0 + 1) + 1) * T y.length =
        2 * (c * ((S 0 + 1) * T y.length)) + T y.length := by ring
    rw [e]
    omega
  set kD := LogProg.bankK Ms + LogProg.bankK Ms with hkD
  have hk2 : kD * (2 * B + 1) ≤ kD * ((8 * (c0 + c1) + 3) * T y.length) :=
    Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ h2B
  have e : (M.k * (2 * c * (S 0 + 1) + 1) + 4 + kD * (8 * (c0 + c1) + 3)) * T y.length =
      M.k * ((2 * c * (S 0 + 1) + 1) * T y.length) + 4 * T y.length +
        kD * ((8 * (c0 + c1) + 3) * T y.length) := by ring
  rw [e]
  omega

/-- **Padding transfers space bounds down** ([AB09, Exercise 3.2], the padding argument in space
form): if `L ∈ SPACE S`, then the language of `L`'s members padded by `C · (|x| + 1)^d` ones lies
in `SPACE T` for every `T` with `m + 1 ≤ T m` (room to validate the padding and to copy the first
component) and `S n ≤ T (2n + 2 + C (n + 1)^d)` (room for `L`'s decider, at the padded length
`|pairEncode x 1^{C (|x|+1)^d}| = 2|x| + 2 + C (|x| + 1)^d`).

**Proof sketch.** Let `M` decide `L` within `c · S` cells. On input `y`, first check that `y` is a
pair `pairEncode x w` whose second component `w` consists of exactly `C (|x| + 1)^d` ones;
reject otherwise. That needs `O(log |y|) ⊆ O(|y| + 1)` cells, on malformed inputs too, and never
writes the pad. Then run `M` on `x`, read in place as a virtual input, and answer as `M` does,
within `c · S |x|` cells for `M` plus `O(|y| + 1)` for the simulation. For a validated `y`,
`|y| = 2|x| + 2 + C (|x| + 1)^d`, so `S |x| ≤ T |y|`, and both phases fit in `O(T |y|)`.

**Implementation.** Three machines and the catalog's conditional
(`Turing.FinTM.computesFunInTime_cond_spaceUsed`): the validator decides the padded words in
logarithmic space (`epad_V_mem`, an abstract register machine through
`Complexity.LogProg.arm_decides_poly`); on a padded word the run phase (`epad_run`) runs `M`
through the oracle-input simulator `Complexity.LogProg.OIS.compile_decides` on the virtual
input `epadVirt y` (the first component of a padded word, `[]` otherwise), whose length and bit
queries a bank of two logspace deciders answers (`epad_Q_mem`); otherwise the constant `[false]`
machine answers. The run phase's space is
`M.k (2 c S |v| + 1) + |bits (|v| + 1)| + 2 + k_D (2B + 1)` with `B = O(|y| + 1)`;
`S |v| ≤ (S 0 + 1) T |y|` both on padded words (by `hST`) and off them (`v = []`), and
`|y| + 1 ≤ T |y|` absorbs the rest. -/
theorem mem_SPACE_padLang {L : Language Bool} {S T : ℕ → ℕ} (C d : ℕ) (hL : L ∈ SPACE S)
    (hST : ∀ n, S n ≤ T (2 * n + 2 + C * (n + 1) ^ d)) (hT : ∀ m, m + 1 ≤ T m) :
    padLang L (fun n => C * (n + 1) ^ d) ∈ SPACE T := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨K, O, hO⟩ := epad_run C d hL hST hT
  have hV := epad_V_mem C d
  rw [LOGSPACE_eq, mem_SPACE_iff] at hV
  obtain ⟨cV, D, hD⟩ := hV
  rw [FinTM.decidesInSpace_iff] at hD
  obtain ⟨hDt, hDs⟩ := hD.computesFunInTime_and_forall_spaceUsed_le
  obtain ⟨hOt, hOs⟩ := hO.computesFunInTime_and_forall_spaceUsed_le
  obtain ⟨Mf, cf, hMf, hMfs⟩ := FinTM.computesFunInTime_const_spaceUsed [false]
  obtain ⟨Mc, cc, hMc, hMcs⟩ := FinTM.computesFunInTime_cond_spaceUsed
    (p := fun y => MultiTapeTM.indicator (epadV C d : Set (List Bool)) y)
    (fun n => cV * logSpace n) (fun n => K * T n) (fun _ => cf) hDt hOt hMf hDs hOs hMfs
  rw [mem_SPACE_iff]
  refine ⟨cV + K + cf + cc, Mc, ?_⟩
  rw [FinTM.decidesInSpace_iff, FinTM.computesInSpace_iff]
  intro y
  have hout : (if MultiTapeTM.indicator (epadV C d : Set (List Bool)) y = true then
      [MultiTapeTM.indicator (L : Set (List Bool)) (epadVirt C d y)] else [false]) =
      [MultiTapeTM.indicator (padLang L (fun n => C * (n + 1) ^ d) : Set (List Bool)) y] := by
    rw [LogProg.indicator_eq_decide, LogProg.indicator_eq_decide, LogProg.indicator_eq_decide]
    by_cases hval : epadValid C d y
    · have hmem : y ∈ (epadV C d : Set (List Bool)) := epad_mem_V.mpr hval
      rw [epadVirt_of_valid hval]
      obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hval
      have hpad : y ∈ (padLang L (fun n => C * (n + 1) ^ d) : Set (List Bool)) ↔
          pairFstD y ∈ (L : Set (List Bool)) := by
        rw [ha, pairFstD_pairEncode]
        constructor
        · intro h
          obtain ⟨x, hx, hxe⟩ := mem_padLang_iff.mp h
          have := congrArg pairFstD hxe
          rw [pairFstD_pairEncode, pairFstD_pairEncode] at this
          rw [this]; exact hx
        · intro h
          exact mem_padLang_iff.mpr ⟨a, h, rfl⟩
      simp only [hmem, decide_true, if_true, List.cons.injEq, and_true]
      exact decide_eq_decide.mpr hpad.symm
    · have hmem : y ∉ (epadV C d : Set (List Bool)) := fun h => hval (epad_mem_V.mp h)
      have hpad : y ∉ (padLang L (fun n => C * (n + 1) ^ d) : Set (List Bool)) := by
        intro h
        obtain ⟨x, -, hxe⟩ := mem_padLang_iff.mp h
        exact hval ⟨x, hxe⟩
      simp only [hmem, decide_false, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false, hpad]
  have hc := (FinTM.computesFunInTime_iff _ _ _).mp hMc y
  rw [hout] at hc
  refine ⟨_, hc, (hMcs y _).trans ?_⟩
  have hTy := hT y.length
  have h1 : cV * logSpace y.length ≤ cV * T y.length :=
    Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ ((logSpace_le_succ _).trans hTy)
  have h2 : max (K * T y.length) cf ≤ K * T y.length + cf * T y.length :=
    max_le (Nat.le_add_right _ _) (le_add_left (Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right _ (by omega)))
  have h3 : cc ≤ cc * T y.length := Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right _ (by omega)
  have e : (cV + K + cf + cc) * T y.length =
      cV * T y.length + K * T y.length + cf * T y.length + cc * T y.length := by ring
  rw [e]
  omega

end Complexity
```

## ===== TCSlib/Complexity/SpaceComplexity/Basic.lean =====

```
/-
Copyright (c) 2026 TCSlib contributors. All rights reserved.
Released under Apache 2.0 license as described in the file LICENSE.
Authors: Hydroxyi
-/
import Mathlib.Data.Nat.Log
import TCSlib.Complexity.ClassP.DTIME
import TCSlib.Complexity.TuringMachine.Encoding

set_option maxHeartbeats 0
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
set_option autoImplicit false

/-!
# Space-bounded computation, `SPACE`, `L`, and implicitly logspace computable functions

[AB09, Def 4.1]: a language is in `SPACE(s(n))` when some machine decides it while
visiting at most `c · s(n)` work-tape cells on every input of length `n`; `L = SPACE(log n)`
[AB09, Def 4.5]. [AB09, Def 4.16]: a function `f` is *implicitly logspace computable* when it
is polynomially bounded and the two languages "the `i`-th bit of `f(x)` is `1`" and
"`i` is a position of `f(x)`" are in `L`.

## The machine model

We reuse the campaign's machines (`Turing.FinTM Bool`) unchanged. They already have the
shape of [AB09, Fig. 4.1]:

* **the input tape is read-only**: a transition (`Turing.Action`) has no write component
  for the input tape, only a head move, clamped to the input and its two boundary blanks;
* **the output tape is write-once, append-only**: a step appends at most one symbol;
* **space is the number of work-tape cells visited** (`Turing.MultiTapeTM.spaceUsed`, the
  sum over the work tapes of the visited cells), exactly the measure of [AB09, Def 4.1]
  ("at most `c · s(n)` locations on M's work tapes (excluding the input tape) are ever
  visited by M's head").

## Main definitions

* `Turing.FinTM.ComputesInSpace` — `M` computes `f`, halting on every input, visiting at most
  `s(|x|)` work cells.
* `Turing.FinTM.DecidesInSpace` — `M` decides `L` within space `s`. [AB09, Def 4.1]
* `Complexity.SPACE` — the class of languages decidable in space `c · s(n)`. [AB09, Def 4.1]
* `Complexity.logSpace` — the logarithmic space bound `⌊log₂ n⌋ + 1`.
* `Complexity.LOGSPACE` — the class `L = SPACE(log n)`. [AB09, Def 4.5]
* `Complexity.indexLang` — the language `{⟨x, i⟩ | p x i}` with `i` in binary.
* `Complexity.ImplicitlyLogspaceComputable` — [AB09, Def 4.16].

## Main results

* `Turing.FinTM.computesInSpace_iff`, `Complexity.logSpace_eq` — the definitions of
  `ComputesInSpace` and `logSpace` as an equivalence and an equation.
* `Turing.FinTM.decidesInSpace_iff`, `Complexity.mem_SPACE_iff`, `Complexity.LOGSPACE_eq` —
  the definitions of `DecidesInSpace`, `SPACE` and `LOGSPACE`, unfolded.
* `Complexity.SPACE.mono` — `SPACE` is monotone in the space bound.
* `Complexity.logSpace_le_succ`, `Complexity.logSpace_le_of_le_mul_two_pow` — the logarithmic
  bound is at most linear, and at most `(A + 1) s` below `A · 2^s`.
* `Complexity.logSpace_le_size_succ` — the logarithmic bound is at most one more than the
  binary length.
* `Complexity.SPACE.mono_const` — `SPACE` absorbs constant factors (added 2026-10-10).
* `Turing.FinTM.computesInSpace_zero_of_k_eq_zero` — no work tapes, zero space (added
  2026-10-10).

## Divergences from [AB09]

* **The logarithm.** [AB09] writes `SPACE(log n)` and requires `s(n) ≥ log n` (p. 79). We use
  `logSpace n = ⌊log₂ n⌋ + 1`, which is at least `1` (so short inputs get constant space, the
  standard reading of the convention) and is `Θ(log n)` for `n ≥ 2`.
* **Pairs and indices** (Def 4.16). The pair `⟨x, i⟩` is `Turing.pairEncode x (Nat.bits i)`:
  the campaign's self-delimiting pairing with the index in little-endian binary without
  redundant zeros (`Nat.bits 0 = []`). Indices are **`0`-based**: the bit language is
  `{⟨x, i⟩ | f(x)ᵢ = 1}` with `f(x)ᵢ` the `i`-th bit from `0`, and the length language is
  `{⟨x, i⟩ | i < |f(x)|}` where [AB09] writes `i ≤ |f(x)|` for `1`-based `i`.
* **Polynomial bound** (Def 4.16). [AB09] asks `|f(x)| ≤ |x|^c`; at `x = ε` that forces
  `f(ε) = ε` for `c ≥ 1`. We use the campaign normal form `|f(x)| ≤ C · (|x| + 1)^c`
  (`Complexity.PolyBound` shape).
* **Halting.** Deciding (resp. computing) includes halting on every input, as in [AB09]
  ("a TM M deciding L"); the space bound is checked at the halting time, and since space is
  monotone in time and frozen after halting this is the space of the whole computation.
* **One measure for both classes.** [AB09, Def 4.1]'s own wording splits: *visited*
  work-tape locations for `SPACE` (the clause quoted above) but *nonblank* locations for
  `NSPACE`. The campaign convention is the visited-cells measure for both; the planned
  `NSPACE` (`AroraBarakChapters3-4Plan.md`, phase P4.1) counts visited cells along every
  choice word, with all branches halting.
* **Zero bounds collapse the class** (P0 reception audit, round 1, finding 1): every
  work tape's visited set contains its origin, so every machine satisfies
  `M.k ≤ spaceUsed` on every input at every time. A single length with `s n = 0`
  therefore forces a deciding machine to have **no work tapes at all** — and then it
  has zero space on *every* input — so `SPACE s = SPACE (fun _ => 0)` (semantically
  the two-way-finite-automaton class) whenever `s` has a zero; multiplicative
  absorption cannot repair this, since `c * 0 = 0`. In particular the literal
  `SPACE (fun n => n)` is **not** linear space: `n = 0` collapses it. **Campaign
  convention:** every asymptotic chapter statement uses an everywhere-positive bound —
  `fun n => n + 1`, `fun n => n ^ c + 1`, `Complexity.logSpace` — never a bound with a
  zero. The characterization and the harmless-normalization identities are the sanity
  layer `TCSlib.Complexity.SpaceComplexity.ZeroSpace`.

## References

* [AB09] S. Arora, B. Barak, *Computational Complexity: A Modern Approach*,
  Cambridge University Press, 2009. (§4.1, Definitions 4.1 and 4.5; §4.3, Definition 4.16.)
-/

namespace Turing.FinTM

/-- The machine `M` computes `f` in space `s`: on every input `x` it halts with output `f x`,
and up to that time it has visited at most `s |x|` work-tape cells (summed over its work
tapes). The input tape (read-only) and the output tape (append-only) do not count.
[AB09, Def 4.1, for functions] -/
def ComputesInSpace (M : FinTM Bool) (f : List Bool → List Bool) (s : ℕ → ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∀ x : List Bool, ∃ t, M.ComputesInTime x (f x) t ∧
    M.tm.spaceUsed (M.tm.initCfg x) t ≤ s x.length

/-- **Computing in space, unfolded**: `M` computes `f` in space `s` exactly when on every input
`x` there is a time `t` at which `M` has halted with output `f x`
(`Turing.FinTM.ComputesInTime`), having visited at most `s |x|` work-tape cells by then. -/
theorem computesInSpace_iff (M : FinTM Bool) (f : List Bool → List Bool) (s : ℕ → ℕ) :
    M.ComputesInSpace f s ↔
      ∀ x : List Bool, ∃ t, M.ComputesInTime x (f x) t ∧
        M.tm.spaceUsed (M.tm.initCfg x) t ≤ s x.length :=
  Iff.rfl

/-- The machine `M` decides `L` in space `s`: it computes the indicator `[x ∈ L]` (a
one-bit output) in space `s`. [AB09, Def 4.1] -/
def DecidesInSpace (M : FinTM Bool) (L : Language Bool) (s : ℕ → ℕ) : Prop :=
  M.ComputesInSpace (fun x => [MultiTapeTM.indicator (L : Set (List Bool)) x]) s

/-- **Deciding in space, unfolded**: `M` decides `L` in space `s` exactly when it computes the
one-bit indicator `x ↦ [x ∈ L]` in space `s`. -/
theorem decidesInSpace_iff (M : FinTM Bool) (L : Language Bool) (s : ℕ → ℕ) :
    M.DecidesInSpace L s ↔
      M.ComputesInSpace (fun x => [MultiTapeTM.indicator (L : Set (List Bool)) x]) s :=
  Iff.rfl

/-- A space bound can be weakened. -/
theorem ComputesInSpace.mono {M : FinTM Bool} {f : List Bool → List Bool} {s s' : ℕ → ℕ}
    (h : M.ComputesInSpace f s) (hs : ∀ n, s n ≤ s' n) : M.ComputesInSpace f s' := by
  intro x
  obtain ⟨t, ht, hsp⟩ := h x
  exact ⟨t, ht, hsp.trans (hs _)⟩

/-- A machine with no work tapes computes in zero space whatever it computes at all: the
space measure counts only work-tape cells. (Shared by the zero-space layer; added
2026-10-10.)

**Proof sketch.** With `M.k = 0` the space measure is an empty sum
(`Turing.MultiTapeTM.spaceUsed_zero_tapes_eq_zero`), at every halting time. -/
theorem computesInSpace_zero_of_k_eq_zero {M : FinTM Bool} {f : List Bool → List Bool}
    (hk : M.k = 0) (h : ∀ x, ∃ t, M.ComputesInTime x (f x) t) :
    M.ComputesInSpace f fun _ => 0 := by
  intro x
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := h x
  exact ⟨t, ht, (MultiTapeTM.spaceUsed_zero_tapes_eq_zero (tm := M.tm) _ t hk).le⟩

end Turing.FinTM

namespace Complexity

open Turing

/-- **`SPACE(s)`** [AB09, Def 4.1]: the languages decided by some finite binary-alphabet
machine visiting at most `c · s(n)` work-tape cells on inputs of length `n`, for some
constant `c`. -/
def SPACE (s : ℕ → ℕ) : Set (Language Bool) :=
  {L | ∃ (c : ℕ) (M : FinTM Bool), M.DecidesInSpace L fun n => c * s n}

/-- **Membership in `SPACE`, unfolded**: `L ∈ SPACE s` exactly when some machine decides `L` in
space `c · s` for some constant `c`. -/
theorem mem_SPACE_iff {s : ℕ → ℕ} {L : Language Bool} :
    L ∈ SPACE s ↔ ∃ (c : ℕ) (M : FinTM Bool), M.DecidesInSpace L fun n => c * s n :=
  Iff.rfl

/-- `SPACE` is monotone in the space bound. -/
theorem SPACE.mono {s₁ s₂ : ℕ → ℕ} (h : ∀ n, s₁ n ≤ s₂ n) : SPACE s₁ ⊆ SPACE s₂ := by
  rintro L ⟨c, M, hM⟩
  exact ⟨c, M, hM.mono fun n => Nat.mul_le_mul_left c (h n)⟩

/-- `SPACE` absorbs constant factors: if `s₁ ≤ a · s₂` pointwise, then
`SPACE s₁ ⊆ SPACE s₂`. [AB09, Def 4.1: the constant `c` absorbs `a`] (Shared by the
zero-space layer and the hierarchy arguments; added 2026-10-10.)

**Proof sketch.** A witness at constant `c` for `s₁` is a witness at constant `c · a`
for `s₂`, since `c · s₁ n ≤ c · (a · s₂ n) = (c · a) · s₂ n`
(`Turing.FinTM.ComputesInSpace.mono`). -/
theorem SPACE.mono_const {s₁ s₂ : ℕ → ℕ} {a : ℕ} (h : ∀ n, s₁ n ≤ a * s₂ n) :
    SPACE s₁ ⊆ SPACE s₂ := by
  rintro L ⟨c, M, hM⟩
  refine ⟨c * a, M, hM.mono fun n => ?_⟩
  calc c * s₁ n ≤ c * (a * s₂ n) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left c (h n)
    _ = c * a * s₂ n := (Nat.mul_assoc c a (s₂ n)).symm

/-- The logarithmic space bound `⌊log₂ n⌋ + 1`: `Θ(log n)`, and at least `1`, following the
convention `s(n) ≥ log n` of [AB09, p. 79]. -/
def logSpace (n : ℕ) : ℕ := Nat.log 2 n + 1

/-- The logarithmic bound's formula: `logSpace n = Nat.log 2 n + 1`. -/
theorem logSpace_eq (n : ℕ) : logSpace n = Nat.log 2 n + 1 := rfl

/-- The logarithmic bound is at most linear: `logSpace n ≤ n + 1`.

**Proof sketch.** `Nat.log 2 n ≤ n` (`Nat.log_le_self`), then `Complexity.logSpace_eq`. -/
theorem logSpace_le_succ (n : ℕ) : logSpace n ≤ n + 1 := by
  have := Nat.log_le_self 2 n
  rw [logSpace_eq]
  omega

/-- The logarithmic width is at most one more than the binary length:
`logSpace n ≤ Nat.size n + 1`.

**Proof sketch.** At `n = 0` both sides are `1`. Otherwise `2 ^ Nat.log 2 n ≤ n < 2 ^ Nat.size n`
(`Nat.pow_log_le_self`, `Nat.lt_size_self`), so `Nat.log 2 n < Nat.size n`. -/
lemma logSpace_le_size_succ (n : ℕ) : logSpace n ≤ Nat.size n + 1 := by
  unfold logSpace
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos n with h | h
  · subst h; simp
  · have h1 : 2 ^ Nat.log 2 n ≤ n := Nat.pow_log_le_self 2 (by omega)
    have h2 : n < 2 ^ Nat.size n := Nat.lt_size_self n
    have : Nat.log 2 n < Nat.size n :=
      (Nat.pow_lt_pow_iff_right (show 1 < 2 by norm_num)).mp (lt_of_le_of_lt h1 h2)
    omega

/-- A number at most `A · 2^s` (with `s ≥ 1`) has `logSpace` at most `(A + 1) s`. -/
theorem logSpace_le_of_le_mul_two_pow {v A s : ℕ} (h : v ≤ A * 2 ^ s) (hs : 1 ≤ s) :
    logSpace v ≤ (A + 1) * s := by
  have hA : A < 2 ^ A := Nat.lt_two_pow_self
  have hlt : v < 2 ^ (A + s) := by
    rw [pow_add]
    exact lt_of_le_of_lt h (Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hA (Nat.two_pow_pos s))
  have hle : A + s ≤ (A + 1) * s := by
    have := Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right A (show 0 < s by omega)
    rw [Nat.add_mul, Nat.one_mul]; omega
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos v with rfl | hv
  · simp only [logSpace, Nat.log_zero_right]; omega
  · have := Nat.log_lt_of_lt_pow (by omega) hlt
    simp only [logSpace]; omega

/-- **The class `L`** [AB09, Def 4.5]: `L = SPACE(log n)`, the languages decidable by a
machine visiting `O(log n)` work-tape cells. (Named `LOGSPACE` to keep the letter `L` free
for language variables.) -/
def LOGSPACE : Set (Language Bool) := SPACE logSpace

/-- `LOGSPACE` is `SPACE logSpace`. -/
theorem LOGSPACE_eq : LOGSPACE = SPACE logSpace := rfl

/-- The language `{⟨x, i⟩ | p x i}`, the pair encoded as `Turing.pairEncode x (Nat.bits i)`
(index in little-endian binary). The shape of the two languages of [AB09, Def 4.16]. -/
def indexLang (p : List Bool → ℕ → Prop) : Language Bool :=
  {w | ∃ x i, w = pairEncode x (Nat.bits i) ∧ p x i}

/-- **Implicitly logspace computable functions** [AB09, Def 4.16]: `f` is polynomially
bounded, `|f(x)| ≤ C · (|x| + 1)^c`, and both the bit language
`{⟨x, i⟩ | f(x)ᵢ = 1}` and the length language `{⟨x, i⟩ | i < |f(x)|}` are in `L`.
Indices are `0`-based and written in binary (`Nat.bits`); see the module docstring for the
divergences (`0`-based `i < |f(x)|` for the book's `1`-based `i ≤ |f(x)|`, and the `+ 1`
in the polynomial bound). -/
def ImplicitlyLogspaceComputable (f : List Bool → List Bool) : Prop :=
  (∃ C c : ℕ, ∀ x : List Bool, (f x).length ≤ C * (x.length + 1) ^ c) ∧
  indexLang (fun x i => (f x).getD i false = true) ∈ LOGSPACE ∧
  indexLang (fun x i => i < (f x).length) ∈ LOGSPACE

/-- `logSpace` is monotone. -/
lemma logSpace_mono {a b : ℕ} (h : a ≤ b) : logSpace a ≤ logSpace b := by
  unfold logSpace
  have := Nat.log_mono_right (b := 2) h
  omega

end Complexity
```

```
/-

Authors: Seyoon Ragavan
-/
import TCSlib.Complexity.ClassNP.PolyTimePairing
import TCSlib.Complexity.ClassP.P
import TCSlib.Complexity.TuringMachine.Encoding
import TCSlib.Complexity.TuringMachine.Build.Primitives

set_option maxHeartbeats 0
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
set_option autoImplicit false

/-!
# The class NP

[AB09, §2.1, Definition 2.1]: a language `L` is in `NP` when membership has
polynomial-length certificates verifiable in polynomial time — `x ∈ L` iff some
certificate `u` of the prescribed polynomial length makes the verifier accept.

## Design and deviations from [AB09]

* **The certificate length is an explicit polynomial formula**, exactly
  `C · (|x| + 1)^c` bits: the definition quantifies over the *coefficient and
  degree*, not over an abstract length function. This is the phase-1 audit's
  repair (findings 1-2, Argument A): a length function constrained only by a
  numerical bound can itself smuggle undecidable information through length
  arithmetic — certificate *content* never enters — putting every
  length-determined language in the class. An explicit formula is computable,
  monotone, and information-free by construction. The numerical helper
  `Complexity.PolyBound` survives for bound bookkeeping only; it never appears
  in a class definition.
* **The verifier is a language, not a machine.** We render "polynomial-time TM
  `M` with `M(x, u) = 1`" as membership of the concatenation `x ++ u` in a
  verifier language `V ∈ P` — reusing the audited Chapter-1 class. The phase-1
  audit certified this abstraction sound (finding 10): `V ∈ P` supplies one
  uniform total decider, and for a fixed length formula, `V`'s values off the
  constrained strings change no membership statement.
* **Pairing is concatenation in the exact-length form** ([AB09], footnote 4):
  the definition never splits `x ++ u` — the membership equivalence quantifies
  over `x` and `u` separately, and with the explicit formula, any consumer
  that must recover the split can (`n + n·formula` arithmetic is computable
  and `n ↦ n + C(n+1)^c` is strictly increasing). The **bounded-length**
  variant ([AB09, Exercise 2.1]) is different: with `∃ u, |u| ≤ …` and plain
  concatenation, the empty certificate forces `V ⊆ L`, which collapses every
  prefix-free language to its verifier (audit finding 2, Argument B) — so the
  bounded form below pairs its inputs with the audited self-delimiting
  `Turing.pairEncode` instead.
* **Certificates have length exactly `C(|x|+1)^c`** (Definition 2.1 verbatim,
  with the formula for [AB09]'s "polynomial `p`").

## Main definitions

* `Complexity.NP` — the class NP. [AB09, Definition 2.1]

## Main results

* `Complexity.P_subset_NP` — `P ⊆ NP` (empty certificates). [AB09, §2.1]
* `Complexity.mem_NP_iff_exists_length_le` — bounded-length *paired*
  certificates define the same class. [AB09, Exercise 2.1, repaired per the
  phase-1 audit]

## References

* [AB09] S. Arora, B. Barak, *Computational Complexity: A Modern Approach*,
  Cambridge University Press, 2009. (§2.1, Definition 2.1, pp. 39-41;
  Exercise 2.1.)
-/

namespace Complexity

open Turing

/-- **The class NP** [AB09, Definition 2.1]: `L ∈ NP` iff there are a certificate
coefficient `C`, degree `c`, and a polynomial-time-decidable verifier language
`V ∈ P` such that `x ∈ L` exactly when some certificate `u` of length exactly
`C · (|x| + 1)^c` makes the concatenation `x ++ u` a member of `V`. The
certificate length is an explicit formula in `|x|` — never an abstract
function — so it is computable and carries no information beyond `|x|`
(phase-1 audit, finding 1). -/
def NP : Set (Language Bool) :=
  {L | ∃ (C c : ℕ) (V : Language Bool), V ∈ P ∧
    ∀ x : List Bool, x ∈ L ↔
      ∃ u : List Bool, u.length = C * (x.length + 1) ^ c ∧ x ++ u ∈ V}

/-- **`P ⊆ NP`** [AB09, §2.1, after Definition 2.1]: a language decidable in
polynomial time is verifiable with empty certificates.

**Proof sketch.** Take `C = 0` (certificate length `0 · (n+1)^0 = 0`) and
`V = L`: the only certificate of length `0` is `[]`, and `x ++ [] = x`, so the
membership equivalence is the identity. The audit confirmed this covers
`L = ∅`, `L = univ`, and `x = []` (finding table, question 2). -/
theorem P_subset_NP : P ⊆ NP := by
  intro L hL
  refine ⟨0, 0, L, hL, fun x => ?_⟩
  simp only [zero_mul, List.length_eq_zero_iff, exists_eq_left, List.append_nil]


/-- Remove the last `true` marker and the following false suffix. No marker
means failure, so stripping cannot cross the certificate boundary. -/
private def stripCertificate : List Bool → Option (List Bool)
  | [] => none
  | b :: v => match stripCertificate v with
    | some u => some (b :: u)
    | none => if b then some [] else none

/-- An all-false certificate region contains no marker. -/
private lemma stripCertificate_false (k : ℕ) :
    stripCertificate (List.replicate k false) = none := by
  induction k with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ k ih => simp [List.replicate_succ, stripCertificate, ih]

/-- Stripping a padded certificate recovers the original certificate, including
the empty certificate and certificates that themselves contain `true`. -/
private lemma stripCertificate_pad (u : List Bool) (k : ℕ) :
    stripCertificate (u ++ true :: List.replicate k false) = some u := by
  induction u with
  | nil => simp [stripCertificate, stripCertificate_false]
  | cons b u ih => simp [stripCertificate, ih]

/-- Successful stripping identifies precisely the last-true decomposition.

**Proof sketch.** Induct from the right through the recursive call. A marker in
the tail survives, with the head prepended; otherwise the head must be `true`
and the tail must be all false. The simultaneous no-marker assertion supplies
that latter fact. -/
private lemma stripCertificate_spec (v : List Bool) :
    (stripCertificate v = none ↔ v = List.replicate v.length false) ∧
    (∀ u, stripCertificate v = some u ↔
      ∃ k, v = u ++ true :: List.replicate k false) := by
  induction v with
  | nil => simp [stripCertificate]
  | cons b v ih =>
    cases hv : stripCertificate v with
    | none =>
      have hfalse := ih.1.mp hv
      constructor
      · constructor
        · intro h
          cases b with
          | false => simpa [List.replicate_succ] using congrArg (false :: ·) hfalse
          | true => simp [stripCertificate, hv] at h
        · intro h
          rw [h]
          exact stripCertificate_false _
      · intro u
        constructor
        · intro h
          cases b with
          | false => simp [stripCertificate, hv] at h
          | true =>
            have hu : u = [] := by simpa [stripCertificate, hv] using h.symm
            subst u
            exact ⟨v.length, by simpa using congrArg (true :: ·) hfalse⟩
        · rintro ⟨j, hj⟩
          rw [hj]
          exact stripCertificate_pad u j
    | some w =>
      obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := (ih.2 w).mp hv
      constructor
      · constructor
        · simp [stripCertificate, hv]
        · intro heq
          have : stripCertificate (b :: v) = none := by
            rw [heq]; exact stripCertificate_false _
          simp [stripCertificate, hv] at this
      · intro u
        constructor
        · intro h
          have hu : b :: w = u := by simpa [stripCertificate, hv] using h
          subst u
          exact ⟨k, by simp [hk]⟩
        · rintro ⟨j, hj⟩
          rw [hj]
          exact stripCertificate_pad u j

/-- The padded total length is strictly increasing, even at degree zero. -/
private lemma certificateTotal_strictMono (C c : ℕ) :
    StrictMono (fun n : ℕ => n + (C + 1) * (n + 1) ^ c) := by
  intro m n h
  dsimp only
  have hpow := Nat.pow_le_pow_left (Nat.add_le_add_right (Nat.le_of_lt h) 1) c
  have hmul := Nat.mul_le_mul_left (C + 1) hpow
  omega

/-- The repaired exact width leaves room for the mandatory marker. -/
private lemma certificate_room (C c n : ℕ) :
    C * (n + 1) ^ c + 1 ≤ (C + 1) * (n + 1) ^ c := by
  have h := Nat.one_le_pow c (n + 1) (Nat.succ_pos n)
  rw [Nat.add_mul, Nat.one_mul]
  omega

/-- Bounded search for the unique legal split. Failure remains `none`. -/
private def certificateSplit (C c m : ℕ) : Option ℕ :=
  (List.range (m + 1)).find? fun n => n + (C + 1) * (n + 1) ^ c == m

/-- The bounded search succeeds exactly at a solution of the length equation.

**Proof sketch.** Any solution is at most the total length, hence lies in the
search range. A failed search would reject that very solution; a successful
search returns a solution, and strict monotonicity makes it unique. -/
private lemma certificateSplit_spec (C c m n : ℕ) :
    certificateSplit C c m = some n ↔ n + (C + 1) * (n + 1) ^ c = m := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hh := List.find?_some (p := fun i => i + (C + 1) * (i + 1) ^ c == m) h
    simpa only [beq_iff_eq] using hh
  · intro h
    have hn : n ∈ List.range (m + 1) := by simp only [List.mem_range]; omega
    cases hs : certificateSplit C c m with
    | none =>
      have hf := (List.find?_eq_none.mp hs) n hn
      simp [h] at hf
    | some j =>
      have hj : j + (C + 1) * (j + 1) ^ c = m :=
        by
          have hh := List.find?_some (p := fun i => i + (C + 1) * (i + 1) ^ c == m) hs
          simpa only [beq_iff_eq] using hh
      have : j = n := (certificateTotal_strictMono C c).injective (hj.trans h.symm)
      simp [this]

/-- In particular the empty input has no legal split. -/
private lemma certificateSplit_zero (C c : ℕ) : certificateSplit C c 0 = none := by
  cases h : certificateSplit C c 0 with
  | none => rfl
  | some n =>
    have hn := (certificateSplit_spec C c 0 n).mp h
    have hr := certificate_room C c n
    omega

/-- The forward verifier parses the audited pairing, enforces the original
exact width, and consults the old verifier on the concatenated word. -/
private def pairedVerifier (C c : ℕ) (V : Language Bool) : Language Bool :=
  {y | ∃ x u, pairDecode y = some (x, u) ∧
    u.length = C * (x.length + 1) ^ c ∧ x ++ u ∈ V}

/-- On an encoded pair, the forward verifier imposes exactly the prescribed
length test and the old verification condition. -/
private lemma pairedVerifier_pair (C c : ℕ) (V : Language Bool) (x u : List Bool) :
    pairEncode x u ∈ pairedVerifier C c V ↔
      u.length = C * (x.length + 1) ^ c ∧ x ++ u ∈ V := by
  change (∃ a b, pairDecode (pairEncode x u) = some (a, b) ∧
    b.length = C * (a.length + 1) ^ c ∧ a ++ b ∈ V) ↔ _
  simp [pairDecode_pairEncode]

/-- A malformed pair is rejected before consulting the old verifier. -/
private lemma pairedVerifier_malformed (C c : ℕ) (V : Language Bool) (y : List Bool)
    (h : pairDecode y = none) : y ∉ pairedVerifier C c V := by
  rintro ⟨x, u, hp, -⟩
  rw [h] at hp
  cases hp

/-- The reverse verifier rejects a missing length split or marker, rechecks the
original bound after stripping, and consults the old paired verifier. -/
private def paddedVerifier (C c : ℕ) (V : Language Bool) : Language Bool :=
  {y | ∃ n u, certificateSplit C c y.length = some n ∧
    stripCertificate (y.drop n) = some u ∧
    u.length ≤ C * (n + 1) ^ c ∧ pairEncode (y.take n) u ∈ V}

/-- A missing solution of the length equation is rejection, not a default
split. In particular this covers the empty input by `certificateSplit_zero`. -/
private lemma paddedVerifier_no_split (C c : ℕ) (V : Language Bool) (y : List Bool)
    (h : certificateSplit C c y.length = none) : y ∉ paddedVerifier C c V := by
  rintro ⟨n, u, hn, -⟩
  rw [h] at hn
  cases hn

/-- For the prescribed exact width the search recovers precisely the input
boundary; no marker in the input can be mistaken for a certificate marker. -/
private lemma paddedVerifier_append (C c : ℕ) (V : Language Bool) (x v : List Bool)
    (hv : v.length = (C + 1) * (x.length + 1) ^ c) :
    x ++ v ∈ paddedVerifier C c V ↔ ∃ u, stripCertificate v = some u ∧
      u.length ≤ C * (x.length + 1) ^ c ∧ pairEncode x u ∈ V := by
  have hs : certificateSplit C c (x ++ v).length = some x.length := by
    apply (certificateSplit_spec _ _ _ _).mpr
    simp only [List.length_append, hv]
  change (∃ n u, certificateSplit C c (x ++ v).length = some n ∧
    stripCertificate ((x ++ v).drop n) = some u ∧
    u.length ≤ C * (n + 1) ^ c ∧ pairEncode ((x ++ v).take n) u ∈ V) ↔ _
  rw [hs]
  simp

/-- An all-false region is rejected even when the input itself contains true
bits: the strip function is applied only after the recovered boundary. -/
private lemma paddedVerifier_no_marker (C c : ℕ) (V : Language Bool) (x : List Bool) :
    x ++ List.replicate ((C + 1) * (x.length + 1) ^ c) false ∉ paddedVerifier C c V := by
  rw [paddedVerifier_append C c V x _ (List.length_replicate ..)]
  simp only [stripCertificate_false, reduceCtorEq, false_and, exists_false, not_false_eq_true]

/-- Even a correctly marked certificate that fits in the enlarged exact
region is rejected if its stripped witness exceeds the original bound. -/
private lemma paddedVerifier_too_long (C c : ℕ) (V : Language Bool) (x u : List Bool)
    (k : ℕ) (hv : (u ++ true :: List.replicate k false).length =
      (C + 1) * (x.length + 1) ^ c) (hu : C * (x.length + 1) ^ c < u.length) :
    x ++ (u ++ true :: List.replicate k false) ∉ paddedVerifier C c V := by
  rw [paddedVerifier_append C c V x _ hv]
  rintro ⟨u', hs, hu', -⟩
  rw [stripCertificate_pad] at hs
  have he : u = u' := Option.some.inj hs
  subst u'
  exact Nat.not_le_of_lt hu hu'

/-- Padding and stripping give the exact witness equivalence; the runtime
obligations are separate from this purely semantic statement. -/
private lemma paddedVerifier_witness (C c : ℕ) (V : Language Bool) (x : List Bool) :
    (∃ v, v.length = (C + 1) * (x.length + 1) ^ c ∧ x ++ v ∈ paddedVerifier C c V) ↔
    ∃ u, u.length ≤ C * (x.length + 1) ^ c ∧ pairEncode x u ∈ V := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨v, hv, h⟩
    obtain ⟨u, -, hu, hV⟩ := (paddedVerifier_append C c V x v hv).mp h
    exact ⟨u, hu, hV⟩
  · rintro ⟨u, hu, hV⟩
    let k := (C + 1) * (x.length + 1) ^ c - (u.length + 1)
    have hroom : u.length + 1 ≤ (C + 1) * (x.length + 1) ^ c :=
      (Nat.add_le_add_right hu 1).trans (certificate_room C c x.length)
    have hv : (u ++ true :: List.replicate k false).length =
        (C + 1) * (x.length + 1) ^ c := by
      simp only [List.length_append, List.length_cons, List.length_replicate]
      dsimp [k]
      omega
    refine ⟨_, hv, (paddedVerifier_append C c V x _ hv).mpr ?_⟩
    exact ⟨u, stripCertificate_pad u k, hu, hV⟩


/-- The catalog's guarded pair-to-concatenation function. -/
private def verifier_concat (z : List Bool) : List Bool :=
  match pairDecode z with
  | some (a, b) => a ++ b
  | none => []

/-- The two bounded searches are literally equal at the shifted coefficient. -/
private lemma verifier_split_bridge (C c : ℕ) :
    solveSplit (C + 1) c = certificateSplit C c := rfl

/-- The library's reverse scan implements the existing recursive strip spec.

**Proof sketch.** The semantic strip specification gives either an all-false
word or its last-true decomposition. Reversing that decomposition makes the
library scan discard exactly the false suffix and the marker. -/
private lemma verifier_strip_bridge : splitAtLastTrue = stripCertificate := by
  funext v
  cases hs : stripCertificate v with
  | none =>
    have hv := (stripCertificate_spec v).1.mp hs
    rw [hv]
    simp [splitAtLastTrue]
  | some u =>
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := ((stripCertificate_spec v).2 u).mp hs
    rw [hk]
    simp [splitAtLastTrue]

/-- The original-bound test returns one Boolean, rejecting parse failures. -/
private def verifier_bound (C c : ℕ) (z : List Bool) : Bool :=
  match pairDecode z with
  | some (a, b) => decide (b.length ≤ C * (a.length + 1) ^ c)
  | none => false

/-- P8 supplies the timed original-bound test, with its parameters unchanged. -/
private lemma verifier_poly_bound (C c : ℕ) :
    PolyTimeComputable (fun z => [verifier_bound C c z]) := by
  obtain ⟨M, a, hM⟩ := FinTM.computesFunInTime_pairLenCheck C c
  exact ⟨M, a, c + 1, hM⟩

/-- Normalize a `P` decider through the audited capture-and-branch host.
The W3 controller uses `capture_run` to capture the old verifier's complete
singleton verdict, including an emission on its halting transition. -/
private lemma verifier_poly_indicator {V : Language Bool} (hV : V ∈ P) :
    PolyTimeComputable (fun x => [MultiTapeTM.indicator V x]) := by
  obtain ⟨C, c, M, hM⟩ := mem_P_iff.mp hV
  have h : PolyTimeComputable (fun x => [MultiTapeTM.indicator V x]) := ⟨M, C, c, hM⟩
  have hc := polyTimeComputable_ite h (polyTimeComputable_const [true])
    (polyTimeComputable_const [false])
  convert hc using 1
  funext x
  cases MultiTapeTM.indicator V x <;> rfl

/-- A polynomial-time singleton indicator is a polynomial-time decider. -/
private lemma verifier_mem_P {V : Language Bool}
    (h : PolyTimeComputable (fun x => [MultiTapeTM.indicator V x])) : V ∈ P := by
  obtain ⟨M, C, c, hM⟩ := h
  exact mem_P_iff.mpr ⟨C, c, M, hM⟩

/-- The reverse length comparison uses general pairing and P8 at `(1,1)`.

**Proof sketch.** Generate `C(|a|+1)^c` in unary and prepend one bit. Pair the
old payload with this generated word. P8 then tests
`C(|a|+1)^c + 1 ≤ |b| + 1`, exactly the required reverse inequality. -/
private lemma verifier_poly_reverseBound (C c : ℕ) :
    PolyTimeComputable (fun z =>
      [decide (C * ((pairFstD z).length + 1) ^ c ≤ (pairSndD z).length)]) := by
  have hfst := polyTimeComputable_pairFstD
  have hsnd := polyTimeComputable_pairSndD
  obtain ⟨U, a, hU⟩ := FinTM.computesFunInTime_polyUnary C c
  have hgen : PolyTimeComputable (fun x => List.replicate (C * (x.length + 1) ^ c) true) :=
    ⟨U, a, c + 1, hU⟩
  have hpre := polyTimeComputable_of_linear (FinTM.computesFunInTime_prepend [true])
  have hpair := hsnd.pairEncode (hpre.comp (hgen.comp hfst))
  simpa only [Function.comp_def, verifier_bound, pairDecode_pairEncode,
    List.singleton_append, List.length_cons, List.length_replicate, Nat.pow_one,
    Nat.one_mul, Nat.add_le_add_iff_right] using (verifier_poly_bound 1 1).comp hpair

/-- The forward verifier is decided by the guarded exact-width pipeline.

**Proof sketch.** Validate the pairing grammar, test both length inequalities,
concatenate the components, and capture the old decider's verdict. All branches
are timed catalog compositions; malformed words never reach the old verifier. -/
private lemma pairedVerifier_mem_P (C c : ℕ) {V : Language Bool} (hV : V ∈ P) :
    pairedVerifier C c V ∈ P := by
  classical
  have hfalse := polyTimeComputable_const [false]
  have hcat : PolyTimeComputable verifier_concat :=
    polyTimeComputable_of_linear FinTM.computesFunInTime_pairConcat
  have hrun := (verifier_poly_indicator hV).comp hcat
  have hreverse := polyTimeComputable_ite (verifier_poly_reverseBound C c) hrun hfalse
  have hwidth := polyTimeComputable_ite (verifier_poly_bound C c) hreverse hfalse
  have hfinal := polyTimeComputable_ite
    (polyTimeComputable_of_linear FinTM.computesFunInTime_pairValid) hwidth hfalse
  apply verifier_mem_P
  convert hfinal using 1
  funext y
  cases hy : pairDecode y with
  | none =>
    simp [hy, pairedVerifier, MultiTapeTM.indicator]
  | some p =>
    rcases p with ⟨x, u⟩
    by_cases hlo : u.length ≤ C * (x.length + 1) ^ c
    · by_cases hhi : C * (x.length + 1) ^ c ≤ u.length
      · have he := Nat.le_antisymm hlo hhi
        simp [hy, verifier_bound, pairFstD, pairSndD, verifier_concat,
          pairedVerifier, MultiTapeTM.indicator, he]
      · have he : u.length ≠ C * (x.length + 1) ^ c := fun h => hhi h.ge
        simp [hy, verifier_bound, pairFstD, pairSndD,
          pairedVerifier, MultiTapeTM.indicator, hlo, hhi, he]
    · have he : u.length ≠ C * (x.length + 1) ^ c := fun h => hlo h.le
      simp [hy, verifier_bound, pairedVerifier, MultiTapeTM.indicator, hlo, he]

/-- The shifted split machine retains the recovered input as the pair head. -/
private def verifier_split (C c : ℕ) (y : List Bool) : List Bool :=
  match solveSplit (C + 1) c y.length with
  | some n => pairEncode (y.take n) (y.drop n)
  | none => []

/-- Strip only the payload of a valid pair, retaining its original input. -/
private def verifier_strip (z : List Bool) : List Bool :=
  match pairDecode z with
  | some (a, v) =>
    match splitAtLastTrue v with
    | some u => pairEncode a u
    | none => []
  | none => []

/-- The reverse verifier is decided by shifted split, marker, and bound guards.

**Proof sketch.** P10 at `(C+1,c)` recovers and retains the input prefix. A
grammar guard rejects its empty failure output. P9 strips only that pair's
payload; a second grammar guard rejects marker failure. P8 at the original
`(C,c)` rechecks the stripped witness before the captured old paired decider
runs. The search equation gives `n ≤ |y|`, so the retained prefix has exactly
length `n`; the two vocabulary bridges identify the original semantic spec. -/
private lemma paddedVerifier_mem_P (C c : ℕ) {V : Language Bool} (hV : V ∈ P) :
    paddedVerifier C c V ∈ P := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨S, a, hS⟩ := FinTM.computesFunInTime_splitSolve (C + 1) c
  have hsplit : PolyTimeComputable (verifier_split C c) := ⟨S, a, c + 2, hS⟩
  obtain ⟨T, b, hT⟩ := FinTM.computesFunInTime_stripLast
  have hstrip : PolyTimeComputable verifier_strip := ⟨T, b, 2, hT⟩
  have hvalid := polyTimeComputable_of_linear FinTM.computesFunInTime_pairValid
  have hfalse := polyTimeComputable_const [false]
  have hbound := polyTimeComputable_ite (verifier_poly_bound C c)
    (verifier_poly_indicator hV) hfalse
  have hmarked := polyTimeComputable_ite hvalid hbound hfalse
  have hfound := polyTimeComputable_ite hvalid (hmarked.comp hstrip) hfalse
  have hfinal := hfound.comp hsplit
  apply verifier_mem_P
  convert hfinal using 1
  funext y
  cases hs : certificateSplit C c y.length with
  | none =>
    simp [verifier_split, verifier_split_bridge, hs,
      pairDecode, paddedVerifier, MultiTapeTM.indicator]
  | some n =>
    have hn : n ≤ y.length := by
      have heq := (certificateSplit_spec C c y.length n).mp hs
      omega
    cases ht : stripCertificate (y.drop n) with
    | none =>
      simp [verifier_split, verifier_split_bridge, hs,
        verifier_strip, verifier_strip_bridge, ht, pairDecode_pairEncode,
        pairDecode, paddedVerifier, MultiTapeTM.indicator]
    | some u =>
      by_cases hu : u.length ≤ C * (n + 1) ^ c
      · simp [verifier_split, verifier_split_bridge, hs,
          verifier_strip, verifier_strip_bridge, ht, pairDecode_pairEncode,
          verifier_bound, List.length_take, Nat.min_eq_left hn,
          paddedVerifier, MultiTapeTM.indicator, hu]
      · simp [verifier_split, verifier_split_bridge, hs,
          verifier_strip, verifier_strip_bridge, ht, pairDecode_pairEncode,
          verifier_bound, List.length_take, Nat.min_eq_left hn,
          paddedVerifier, MultiTapeTM.indicator, hu]

/-- **Bounded-length paired certificates define the same class**
[AB09, Exercise 2.1, repaired per the phase-1 audit]: `L ∈ NP` iff there are
`C`, `c`, and a verifier `V ∈ P` with
`x ∈ L ↔ ∃ u, |u| ≤ C(|x|+1)^c ∧ pairEncode x u ∈ V`. The bounded form pairs
`x` with `u` via the audited self-delimiting `Turing.pairEncode`: with plain
concatenation the empty certificate would force `V ⊆ L` and collapse every
prefix-free language (audit finding 2, Argument B).

**Proof sketch.** (⇒) From the exact form `(C, c, V)`, take the paired verifier
`V' := {pairEncode x u : |u| = C(|x|+1)^c ∧ x ++ u ∈ V}` with the same bound:
deciding `V'` parses the aligned pair (the `Turing.pairDecode` grammar; a
polynomial-time scan), checks the length equality against the explicit formula,
reassembles `x ++ u`, and runs `V`'s decider — each a named machine obligation
for the fill, none exotic. (⇐) From the bounded form `(C, c, V)`, take exact
length `R n = (C+1)(n+1)^c` — **admissible** for the repaired `NP`
(coefficient `C+1`, degree `c`; the round-2 audit refuted the earlier choice
`C(n+1)^c + 1`, which is not of the class's required shape — round-2
finding 1) — leaving `R n - C(n+1)^c = (n+1)^c ≥ 1` room for the marker. Pad
each certificate right-self-delimitingly to `u ++ [true] ++ false-run` of
length `R n`. The new verifier, on `y` of length `m`: search `n ≤ m` for
`n + R n = m` — strict increase of `n ↦ n + R n` gives **at most one**
solution, and none may exist (e.g. `y = []`, since `R n ≥ 1`): **reject if no
such `n` exists** (round-3 audit, finding 1); otherwise split `y = x ++ v` at
that unique `n` with
`|v| = R n ≥ 1`; reject if `v` has no `true` bit (so stripping never enters
`x`); split `v = u ++ [true] ++ false-run` at the **last** `true`; check the
*original* bound `|u| ≤ C(n+1)^c` — checkable precisely because the bound is
the explicit formula (phase-1 finding 2's residual error, fixed in round 1) —
and consult `V` on `pairEncode x u`. Every old witness pads within `R n`
(`|u| + 1 ≤ C(n+1)^c + 1 ≤ R n`); every accepted new witness strips back to
an old one (the round-2 audit's reconstruction, checked there across the
`C = 0`, `c = 0`, `x = []`, `u = []`, all-`false`, and malformed edge
cases). -/
theorem mem_NP_iff_exists_length_le {L : Language Bool} :
    L ∈ NP ↔ ∃ (C c : ℕ) (V : Language Bool), V ∈ P ∧
      ∀ x : List Bool, x ∈ L ↔
        ∃ u : List Bool, u.length ≤ C * (x.length + 1) ^ c ∧ pairEncode x u ∈ V  := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨C, c, V, hV, hL⟩
    refine ⟨C, c, pairedVerifier C c V, ?_, fun x => ?_⟩
    · -- Remaining machine obligation: aligned parsing, the explicit polynomial
      -- length-equality test, concatenation, and timed execution of V's decider.
      exact pairedVerifier_mem_P C c hV
    · rw [hL x]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨u, hu, hVu⟩
        exact ⟨u, hu.le, (pairedVerifier_pair C c V x u).mpr ⟨hu, hVu⟩⟩
      · rintro ⟨u, -, hVu⟩
        exact ⟨u, (pairedVerifier_pair C c V x u).mp hVu⟩
  · rintro ⟨C, c, V, hV, hL⟩
    refine ⟨C + 1, c, paddedVerifier C c V, ?_, fun x => ?_⟩
    · -- Remaining machine obligation: bounded split search, last-true stripping,
      -- the original-bound test, pairing, and timed execution of V's decider.
      exact paddedVerifier_mem_P C c hV
    · exact (hL x).trans (paddedVerifier_witness C c V x).symm

end Complexity
```

```
/-

Authors: Seyoon Ragavan
```
